criteria.text: Offers clinical laboratory testing panels directly to consumers (direct-to-consumer)
criteria.rationale: Distinguishes consumer-facing lab/testing providers from B2B diagnostics vendors, hospital labs, or purely enterprise software companies.

criteria.text: Operates a subscription or recurring-service model for routine or periodic laboratory testing
criteria.rationale: Separates companies that sell one-off tests from businesses that position testing as an ongoing preventive-health routine similar to Function Health's 120+ tests offering.

criteria.text: Provides physician-led interpretation or expert medical explanations of test results to users
criteria.rationale: Identifies services that combine diagnostics with clinician interpretation versus platforms that only supply raw lab values or technical reports.

criteria.text: Uses artificial intelligence or machine learning to analyze laboratory data or to generate personalized health insights
criteria.rationale: Encodes the user's explicit intent for 'AI' and distinguishes companies applying ML-driven interpretation from those relying solely on standard clinical rules or human review.

criteria.text: Positions its offering around preventive health and longitudinal health monitoring rather than one-time or acute diagnostic testing
criteria.rationale: Separates companies focused on long-term health optimization and monitoring from those focused on single-event diagnostics or specialized acute-care tests.
